decision_origin: Project owner: retain upstream MQ135 NH4 and V6 NH3 interpretations provisionally until laboratory comparison
interpretation: Two separate labeled research hypotheses sharing one numeric relationship, not two independent sensors or exposures. NH4+ is not an independent atmospheric gas measurable as NH4+ ppm by MQ135. If real-world ammonium material volatilizes, emitted NH3 can be assessed only with independent reference gas validation.
requires_lab: verify original meaning and provenance of MQInfo.py NH4 label (possibly notation mistake)
challenge MQ135 under known certified NH3 gas challenge with independent reference analyzer and controlled humidity/heater
if study involves ammonium salts or aqueous NH4+, measure solution pH, temperature and independently measured NH3 vapor; do not call it NH4 gas detection
use group-wise holdout and test cross-sensitivity from other relevant gases
never promote either label to G3 before physically referenced experiment
